set.body:
Define the smallest versioned offline manifest alongside the exported files. Keep historical local manifest and release identities intact.

Acceptance criteria

1. Specify the issuing repository identifier, disclosed release or view identifier, path rules, directories including empty ones, byte length, hash algorithm and canonical inventory digest framing/order.
2. Define permitted description, coverage and provenance fields by disclosure scope. For a restricted view a change confined to a hidden source file must not change the disclosed inventory or reveal its identity.
3. Publish golden examples for an archive and a restricted view. An independent implementation recomputes the same digest and detects a changed byte, missing or extra entry, duplicate path and unsupported format version.
4. State how an expected issuer is established for offline use and how an unverifiable origin is represented. Integrity verification alone must not confer trust or local access.

Verification

Versioned format plus machine-readable golden packages and a verifier that does not import Sanctity's manifest encoder.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: INT02: Specify the portable inventory and issuer-qualified release reference
